id.description: TSID of the comment being replaced; present only on an edit or a tombstone.

capability.description: Deprecated and ignored; some old comment blobs still carry it.

account.description: Stable account authority represented by a delegated signer; omitted when it equals the signer.

space.description: Space of the commented document; omitted when it equals the signer.

path.description: Path of the commented document within `space`.

version.description: CIDs of the document heads the author was looking at; empty means the document at this path.

threadRoot.description: CID of the first comment of the thread; present on every reply.

replyParent.description: CID of the comment this one replies to; omitted when it equals `threadRoot`.

body.description: The comment's content as a list of comment blocks; an empty body is a tombstone.

visibility.description: Empty for a public comment or `Private`, usually copied from the target document.

description: A signed comment on a document version, optionally written by an authorized agent for a stable account authority.
